title: NSE looks to diversify revenue beyond weekly options ahead of ₹22,569 crore IPO
text: NSE looks to diversify revenue beyond weekly options ahead of ₹22,569 crore IPO. Weekly index options contributed 46 per cent of operating revenue in FY26; new businesses gaining ground
